title: Video Editor (Freshers)
summary: Edit short-form and long-form videos for our clients' social media, ads and websites, working closely with our content and marketing team.
responsibilities: Edit reels, shorts and promotional videos for Instagram, YouTube and Facebook
Add captions, music, transitions, motion text and basic colour correction
Turn raw footage and briefs into clear, engaging stories
Prepare videos in the right sizes and formats for each platform
Keep project files and assets organised for the team
requirements: Basic working knowledge of a video editing tool
A sample reel or a few edited videos (college or personal projects count)
Good sense of timing, music and visual storytelling
Willing to learn and take feedback

title: Content Creator (Freshers)
summary: Plan and create social media content for our clients and our own brand: ideas, scripts, captions, simple designs and on-camera content.
responsibilities: Come up with content ideas and monthly post calendars for client brands
Write captions, short scripts and hooks for reels and posts
Shoot simple videos and photos on mobile when needed
Create post designs and stories using Canva
Track what performs well and suggest improvements
requirements: Active interest in Instagram, YouTube and current social media trends
Good written communication in English (Telugu is a plus)
Comfortable presenting ideas and being on camera
Creative, organised and able to meet deadlines

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
qualification: Any graduate (MBA / marketing certification is a plus)
summary: Plan and run digital campaigns for our clients across Google, Meta and search, and report on results that bring them more enquiries.
responsibilities: Set up and manage Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns
Do keyword research and on-page SEO for client websites
Manage social media pages and posting schedules
Track leads, spend and results, and prepare simple monthly reports
Work with the design and content team on ad creatives
requirements: Good understanding of how social media and search advertising work
Comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and reporting
Clear communication with clients and the team
Freshers with a certification or internship are welcome

title: Web Developer (React / Next.js)
summary: Build fast, search-ready business websites and web apps for our clients, working alongside our design and marketing team.
responsibilities: Build responsive pages and features with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Connect forms, CMS content and third-party APIs
Fix bugs and improve page speed on live client sites
Take part in weekly reviews with senior developers
requirements: Good working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Hands-on experience with React (projects or internships count)
Comfortable with Git and reading documentation
